title: Maṇibhaddo
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Magadhesu viharati Maṇimālake cetiye Maṇibhaddassa yakkhassa bhavane || || 2. Atha kho Maṇibhaddo yakkho yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || [Satimato sadā bhaddaṃ || satimā sukham edhati || satimato su ve seyyo || verā ca parimuccatī ti] || || 3. Satimato sadā bhaddaṃ || satimā sukham edhati || satimato su ve seyyo || verā na parimuccati || || yassa sabbam ahorattam || ahiṃsāya rato mano || mettaṃ so sabbabhūtesu || veraṃ tassa na kenacī ti || ||
